decisions: Coverage, job, and option contract records are frozen dataclasses with normalized symbols, enum values, dates, UTC timestamps, and validation at construction.

CatalogRepository, JobRepository, and ContractRepository are Azure-independent protocols; deterministic in-memory repositories sort results by stable logical keys and replace duplicate keys on upsert.
Azure adapters use TableClient only at the persistence boundary, replace entities on upsert to prevent stale optional fields, and catch ResourceNotFoundError as a normal missing-record result.
Coverage partitions are keyed by asset class, data type, and canonical symbol with ISO session dates as row keys; job and contract tables use fixed partition keys and encoded IDs.
Azure Tables have no decimal EDM type, so contract strike prices are persisted as exact decimal strings and restored as Decimal values; no live Azure calls are used by tests.
limitations: The Azure adapter tests use an in-process TableClient-shaped fake and validate entity/query behavior without provisioning or contacting Azure.
